description.en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

description.zh:
目标解析集群是否在线。
> 为兼容旧版本时可以不填，不填时值为对 isRemote 取反。
description.en:
Specifies whether the target cluster is online. 

**Note** This parameter is used for compatibility with earlier versions and can be left empty. When left empty, it specifies negation for the value of `isRemote`.

description.zh: 为兼容老版本，可以为空。
description.en: This parameter is provided for compatibility with earlier versions and can be left empty.

description.zh: 恢复方式。非必填，在 IsRemote=true 时，必填。
description.en: The restore method. This parameter is required when `IsRemote` is set to `true`, and is optional otherwise.
The type of the restore object.
The ID of the backup set.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-restorable-tenants --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --is-remote true --set-id bak-xxxxx --restore-mode from_time_point --biz-method native_logical --is-online true --restore-object-type tenant --region cn-hangzhou
